description: This file defines a class representing a DSCP mapping table within a TLV (Type-Length-Value) framework, including its properties, data types, and associated comments for documentation.

classes.name: tlvDscpMappingTable
classes.description: Represents a DSCP mapping table used in network service prioritization, containing type, length, and mapping data.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type information of the DSCP mapping table.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Specifies the size of the table in 16-bit unsigned integers.

methods.name: dscp_pcp_mapping
methods.description: Array of 64 uint8_t values, each mapping a DSCP value to a PCP value, with associated comment explaining its usage.
